_source: Smithsonian Folkways Archive, catalogued by hand into six per-continent Google Sheets in Jan 2023 and concatenated into the master "Geotracks" sheet (Drive id 1QG0SxPegRN65bc8sHrM8NJqDYRUrijorG4eYWFPVaWY). This file is that master sheet's Group + Title columns, verbatim apart from the resolutions noted below. It is the *catalogue* — the set of albums the app intends to hold — against which src/albums.json is reconciled by scripts/backfill-albums.mjs.

_excluded.reason: Richard Lerman composition recorded across Indonesia, the Netherlands and the US — not one country's music
